title: THE RANSOM
note: Draft from the owner's Hebrew treatment (8.11.2026), fact-checked; see the script document for every correction. Panels are still to be drawn.

beats.say: Your club is chasing the title. Your striker has just scored twice. Then he gets into his car — and disappears.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Barcelona, the first of March, nineteen eighty-one. This is the file on Quini.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: Enrique Castro, Quini. Signed from Sporting Gijón the summer before, Barcelona's centre-forward, Spain's top scorer.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: That evening Barcelona beat Hércules six-nil at the Camp Nou. Quini scores two.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: On his way to collect his family from the airport, two men stop him at gunpoint and force him into a van.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: He is held under the floor of a lock-up in Zaragoza, in a hole about a metre and a half long. Three unemployed men, no plan for the money.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: First they ask three hundred and fifty million pesetas. Then a hundred million. Barcelona have to open the bank account for them.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The team falls apart. Bernd Schuster refused to play the next game: "As well as legs, I have a heart."
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: In Quini's twenty-five days, Barcelona manage one draw in four league games. The title goes to Real Sociedad — their first ever.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The money trail ends at a bank. One of the kidnappers comes to withdraw it, and the police are waiting.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: On the twenty-fifth of March, police break into the lock-up in Zaragoza. Quini is alive.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: The kidnappers got ten years and were ordered to pay him five million pesetas. Quini never took it. He said he forgave them.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

beats.say: That June, Barcelona won the Copa del Rey. The league was gone. The man came home.
beats.camera: One move per beat; hold for the line; the stamp and the score land on the word.

shorts.narration: Barcelona's striker scored twice and then vanished. 1 March 1981, Quini, kidnapped at gunpoint after a 6-0 win. Twenty-five days under a garage floor in Zaragoza. Barça lose the title. He comes home alive, and he forgives the kidnappers. Full file on FanLife.
